title: Announcing Campfire's Basecamp 2026: The Largest AI Conference for Corporate Finance and Accounting Leaders
summary: Campfire's Basecamp 2026 | AI Corporate Finance Conference
body_markdown:
AI is changing corporate finance, largely for the better, but most finance and accounting teams are still stuck on questions like:


- " *How do we actually use AI in our day-to-day work?"*
- *"How do we know which AI outputs to trust?"*
- *"How do we know if AI is delivering value?"*


To answer these types of questions and give corporate finance and accounting practitioners an actionable roadmap to deploy AI, Campfire is thrilled to formally announce the[Basecamp 2026 conference](https://campfire.ai/basecamp) , taking place **October 21–22, 2026, in San Francisco** .


Basecamp 2026 is designed specifically for CFOs, Controllers, VPs of Finance, and other forward-thinking finance and accounting practitioners who are actively weighing and iterating on how to best put AI to work within their teams. Over two days, more than 400 corporate finance and accounting leaders will gather to test new workflows in interactive sessions, learn from expert panelists, and collaborate with one another on what to do (or not do) when it comes to AI.


## **What to Expect at Basecamp 2026**


Campfire built Basecamp as a hands-on, immersive conference that will help attendees walk away with tangible AI use cases. We want you to leave Basecamp ready to go back to your team with proven strategies and tactics to implement AI tools and workflows that help you do your job more efficiently and effectively, while supporting your company's growth.


If you attended Campfire's Finance Forward summit last year, think of Basecamp 2026 as a bigger and better version that will help you stay at the vanguard of AI usage in corporate finance.


This year's conference will include two main days of content:


**Day 1: Live, Interactive AI Working Sessions**


- **Date:** October 21, 2026
- **Location:**[Campfire HQ](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Campfire/@37.7922474,-122.4050988,17z/data=!3m2!4b1!5s0x8085808a13e1074d:0x83f7c3ca39579140!4m6!3m5!1s0x808581c43797bbed:0x772f32e50b057fcc!8m2!3d37.7922474!4d-122.4025239!16s%2Fg%2F11xtn8mhzf?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MDkyNy4xIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D) (Financial District, San Francisco)


On the first day of Basecamp 2026, we’re opening our doors to host three hours of live, hands-on working sessions. Join one (or several) of the six stations that will help you understand real AI use cases and leave with an actionable way to tackle a problem, such as in your close, budget, or other finance workflows.


### **Day 2: Keynotes and Executive Panels**


- **Date:** October 22, 2026
- **Location:**[The Aviary at City View at Metreon](https://www.google.com/maps/place/City+View+at+Metreon/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x0:0xef98e3d7be2cd321?sa=X&ved=1t:2428&ictx=111) (SoMa, San Francisco)


Day two of Basecamp 2026 features expert panel discussions, live software demonstrations, and keynote presentations that will give you insider views of how finance, accounting, and audit leaders are implementing AI, warts and all. Attendees can earn up to 5.2 CPE credits across the day’s track and will have multiple opportunities to network with peers.


## **Featured Session Topics**


Campfire's Basecamp 2026 will feature a range of session topics, but all centered around AI. Some examples include:


- **AI Transformation at Enterprise Scale:** Learn how finance leaders at highly regulated companies are driving AI adoption within their companies while maintaining controls.
- **Rewiring Your Finance Stack for Hyper-Growth:** Finance leaders at some of the top AI-native startups will let you peek under the hood of their modern tech stacks and will share how they're moving quickly with AI while still being mindful of risk.
- **Writing the Playbook for AI-Enabled Audits:** Hear from both sides of how finance teams and auditors are working together on AI-enabled audits to move more efficiently, while recognizing that technology is moving faster than the rules.


## **How to Attend Basecamp 2026**


While full-conference tickets are now waitlist-only, a limited number of spots remain for the **opening reception on October 21** and the **main session day on October 22** .


You can secure your spot via our[Luma registration page](https://luma.com/campfire-basecamp-2026) , which will include a quick vetting process to keep the conversations peer-level at the conference.


Interested in sponsoring Basecamp 2026? A limited number of sponsorship opportunities are still available. To learn more, reach out to the Campfire Basecamp team at[\[email protected\]](https://campfire.ai/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#670211020913142704060a17010e150249060e) .


We look forward to seeing you in San Francisco in a few weeks!
